summary.business_type: Local service business / digital agency (web development for Indonesian UMKM/small businesses) with a portfolio, blog, and a secondary EdTech product (CBT Pro)
top_findings: 7 indexed /demo/* URLs share one identical title, meta description, and canonical (pointing at the homepage) because they are client components that cannot export metadata
/layanan — the main services page — has zero page-specific SEO metadata for the same reason
Two competing sitemap systems (next-sitemap static output vs. native app/sitemap.ts); the flatter, worse-configured static one is what's actually served live
Title tags on /projects, /education, /contact, /blog render as "X | NehanDev | NehanDev" (duplicated suffix)
Homepage's core business JSON-LD schema only loads after JS hydration (afterInteractive), invisible to non-JS crawlers including most AI/GEO bots
quick_wins: Remove "| NehanDev" from the title strings in app/projects/page.tsx, app/education/page.tsx, app/contact/page.tsx, app/blog/page.tsx (4-line fix)
Change the homepage JSON-LD Script strategy from afterInteractive to beforeInteractive (matches the pattern already used correctly on blog posts)
Fix the apex-domain redirect to skip the insecure HTTP hop (nehandev.com -> https://www.nehandev.com directly)
Swap Article schema publisher.logo from favicon.svg to the existing PNG favicon

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correctly allows crawling and points to the sitemap
HTTPS enforced at the end of the redirect chain

findings.title: Two competing sitemap systems; static next-sitemap output shadows the well-configured native app/sitemap.ts
findings.description: public/sitemap.xml + public/sitemap-0.xml are generated by next-sitemap's postbuild step with a flat priority=0.7/changefreq=weekly for every URL, including all /demo/* pages and even a self-referencing entry for sitemap.xml itself. These static files are served ahead of the app/sitemap.ts route (which has correct, differentiated priorities and excludes /demo/*), verified by comparing the live sitemap-0.xml content pattern to next-sitemap's config. The committed public/sitemap.xml also still points at http://localhost:3000, stale from a local build.
findings.recommendation: Remove next-sitemap (config, postbuild script, and the tracked public/sitemap*.xml + public/robots.txt), and rely solely on app/sitemap.ts; add app/robots.ts for the same reason.

findings.title: Apex domain redirects through an insecure HTTP hop before reaching HTTPS
findings.description: curl -IL https://nehandev.com shows https://nehandev.com -> http://www.nehandev.com (301) -> https://www.nehandev.com (301) -- two hops, one of them unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Configure the redirect to go directly from https://nehandev.com to https://www.nehandev.com in a single hop.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage, /projects, /education, /contact, /blog, and blog posts each have distinct, relevant titles and descriptions in code (when the metadata export actually runs)
Blog post pages have correct canonical tags and a single H1

findings.title: 7 indexed /demo/* URLs are duplicate-content clones of the homepage in Google's eyes
findings.description: app/demo/travel, /demo/hotel, /demo/barbershop, /demo/rental, and the travel sub-pages (/destinasi, /paket, /kontak) are all "use client" components, so none can export Next.js metadata. Verified live: every one of these 7 URLs serves the identical sitewide default title ("NehanDev | Professional Web Development Solutions"), identical description, and canonical=https://www.nehandev.com -- explicitly telling Google to treat them as duplicates of the homepage and index that instead.
findings.recommendation: Split each app/demo/*/page.tsx into a server component that exports page-specific metadata (title, description, alternates.canonical) wrapping the existing client UI as a child component -- the pattern already used correctly on /projects and /education.

findings.title: /layanan (main services page) has no page-specific metadata at all
findings.description: app/layanan/page.tsx is a "use client" component and cannot export metadata. Live it serves the sitewide default title/description and canonical=https://www.nehandev.com instead of /layanan -- this is the primary commercial page on the site and it is currently indistinguishable from the homepage to search engines.
findings.recommendation: Same fix pattern as the demo pages: wrap in a server component with its own metadata export and self-referencing canonical.

findings.title: Title tags render as "X | NehanDev | NehanDev" on 4 pages
findings.description: Root layout sets title.template = "%s | NehanDev", but app/projects/page.tsx, app/education/page.tsx, app/contact/page.tsx, and app/blog/page.tsx each already include "| NehanDev" in their own title string, so the suffix is appended twice. Verified live on all 4 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Remove the trailing "| NehanDev" from each page's metadata.title so the layout template supplies it exactly once.

findings.title: Missing <h1> on /projects, /education, /contact
findings.description: Live H1 count is 0 on all three pages (vs. 1 on / and /blog). These pages reuse section components (e.g. education-section.tsx's <h2>) originally designed to sit under the homepage's own <h1>, but which have no top-level heading when used as standalone pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a page-level <h1> to each, or promote the reused section's heading to <h1> when it's the page's primary content.

findings.title: Default OG/Twitter copy is stale relative to the site's actual positioning
findings.description: Homepage title/description are Indonesian and UMKM-focused ("Solusi Digital untuk Usaha Lokal"), but app/layout.tsx's openGraph.title/description and twitter.title/description (used as the fallback for any page, and literally mismatched with the homepage's own <title> on social shares of the homepage itself) still read the old English "Professional Web Development Solutions" pitch.
findings.recommendation: Update the default openGraph/twitter copy in app/layout.tsx to match the current Indonesian-first positioning.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Blog post Article schema (app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx) uses strategy="beforeInteractive", confirmed present in raw (non-JS-rendered) HTML -- correct practice

Homepage schema resolves correctly and validly once JS runs (confirmed via headless-Chromium render): ProfessionalService, Offer, PostalAddress, Service all present with real substituted business data

findings.title: Homepage's core business schema only appears after JS hydration, invisible to non-JS crawlers
findings.description: app/layout.tsx's JSON-LD Script uses strategy="afterInteractive". Verified: raw HTML fetch (curl) contains zero application/ld+json script tags; the block only appears after full Chromium rendering. Many AI/GEO crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) and various SEO/social tools do not execute JavaScript and will never see the site's business identity/schema, even though Googlebot (which renders JS) does pick it up.
findings.recommendation: Switch to strategy="beforeInteractive" with dangerouslySetInnerHTML (matching the working pattern on blog posts), or render the script tag directly in the server component without next/script.

findings.title: PostalAddress is not fully structured
findings.description: The full street/city/region/postal code is crammed into a single streetAddress string rather than split into addressLocality/addressRegion/postalCode, which Google's structured data guidelines expect for full Local Business eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Split the address into its component PostalAddress fields.

findings.title: Article schema publisher.logo uses an SVG favicon
findings.description: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx sets publisher.logo.url to favicon.svg; Google's Article rich-result guidance expects a raster image (PNG/JPG, >=112x112px) for this field.
findings.recommendation: Point publisher.logo.url at the existing web-app-manifest-512x512.png instead.

findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint is 5.1s (poor) on mobile
findings.description: Lab data via PageSpeed Insights: Performance score 71/100, FCP 3.0s, LCP 5.1s (good threshold is <=2.5s), Speed Index 5.5s. Contributing factors flagged by Lighthouse: render-blocking requests (~150ms), unused JavaScript (~450ms/69KiB), legacy JS polyfills (~11KiB). No CrUX field data available yet (insufficient real-user traffic volume for this origin).
findings.recommendation: Identify and prioritize the LCP element (likely hero image or heading), verify next/image priority hints and font preloads are on the critical element, and audit JS bundle size (Framer Motion loaded on every section is a likely contributor).

findings.title: One color-contrast accessibility failure
findings.description: Lighthouse flagged insufficient background/foreground contrast ratio somewhere on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Run Lighthouse's element inspector to locate the specific element and adjust colors to meet WCAG AA contrast.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt does not block any crawler by user-agent, including AI bots
Blog post content and schema are fully visible in raw HTML (good for AI citation)

findings.title: Core business schema is JS-gated (see Schema category) -- the single biggest GEO gap
findings.description: See schema.md -- afterInteractive JSON-LD means non-JS AI crawlers see none of the site's structured business/service data.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as the schema finding: switch to beforeInteractive.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Optional and ignored by Google Search, but an increasingly common convention some AI answer engines check for a citable summary of the site.
findings.recommendation: Low priority; consider adding once higher-severity issues are fixed.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Legal business name, address, phone, email centralized and consistent (lib/business-info.ts)
7 blog posts with relevant local-business topics and reasonable metadata

findings.title: Thin content on /education and /contact (~130 words each)
findings.description: Both pages reuse compact homepage-teaser section components as their entire standalone page content. /education in particular showcases a real product (CBT Pro) but reads more like a teaser than a full product page.
findings.recommendation: Expand /education with more product depth (features, screenshots with descriptive copy, a mini case study); /contact is less critical to expand but could add FAQ or response-time detail.

findings.title: Brand voice inconsistency between page content and default social/schema copy
findings.description: Same underlying issue as the on-page OG/Twitter finding -- stale English positioning surfaces wherever default copy is used instead of page-specific copy.
findings.recommendation: Same fix -- update default copy in app/layout.tsx.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 12 elements on the homepage carry non-empty alt attributes
OG social preview image resolves correctly (200, PNG, 128KB)

findings.title: Image formats/compression on interior pages not independently verified
findings.description: Homepage images checked directly; /demo/* and blog post body images were not individually audited for format/compression in this pass.
findings.recommendation: Spot-check /demo/* and blog post images for WebP/AVIF delivery and reasonable file sizes.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Convert app/demo/*/page.tsx (travel, hotel, barbershop, rental + travel sub-pages) into server components exporting page-specific metadata with self-referencing canonicals
Convert app/layanan/page.tsx to a server component exporting metadata with alternates.canonical: /layanan
Remove next-sitemap entirely; stop tracking public/sitemap*.xml and public/robots.txt; rely on app/sitemap.ts + add app/robots.ts

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Fix duplicated "| NehanDev" title suffix on /projects, /education, /contact, /blog
Switch homepage JSON-LD script strategy from afterInteractive to beforeInteractive
Fix apex-domain redirect to skip the insecure HTTP hop
Investigate and reduce LCP (currently 5.1s mobile) -- prioritize hero element, trim unused JS

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Update default OG/Twitter/JSON-LD copy in app/layout.tsx to match current Indonesian-first positioning
Swap Article schema publisher.logo to a PNG

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run PageSpeed Insights after LCP fixes to confirm improvement
Verify Google Search Console indexation status for /demo/* and /layanan after the metadata fix ships
Consider adding llms.txt once core fixes are live
